quotes.speaker: Chris Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Paul on the importance of communication in team dynamics
quotes.excerpt: Everything is all about the betterment of the team, but the communication aspect is huge.
quotes.quote: It is tough, especially given the existing history of the relationship. I think everything is all about the betterment of the team, but the communication aspect is huge. How it went down, how it happened. Things happen, everything is all about the betterment of the team, but the communication aspect is huge. Mine wasn't the greatest.

quotes.speaker: Chris Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Paul on the culture built by Wake Forest football
quotes.excerpt: I can see why they are winning games.
quotes.quote: I got a chance to go over and talk to the team and what Coach Clawson and his staff has done with the culture. That is one thing, you guys on here all know as athletes, one thing is you can feel energy. So when I went and talked to the guys and you just saw the culture and how they just enjoy being around each other, that was what was dope for me. I can see why they are winning games.

quotes.speaker: Chris Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Paul on the importance of enjoying the college experience
quotes.excerpt: Soak it all in and enjoying the time because it goes by quick.
quotes.quote: That is what I talk to a lot of the guys about, about soaking it all in and enjoying the time because it goes by quick. And when it becomes a job, as you guys know, it is a job. I mean I was here at home. My parents, I grew up 15 minutes away from campus. My granny lived five minutes away. So, you know, my mama still washed my clothes when I was in college. So, it was nothing like playing there.
